desc.zh: 了解原料、製程、成品或作業環境的微生物污染狀況。
desc.en: Assess microbial contamination in raw materials, process, products or work environment.

desc.zh: 進行異常分析化驗，鑑定造成問題的微生物。
desc.en: Analyse abnormalities and identify the microbes responsible.

desc.zh: 提出改善對策，選用合適的微生物控制藥劑。
desc.en: Propose corrective measures and select the right control agents.

desc.zh: 後續追蹤檢測並持續改善，達到有效控制。
desc.en: Follow-up testing and continuous improvement for effective control.
